title: Episode About Marathas And the Khalsa Panth...

blocks.text: As the quarrel sharpens, Dina Beg warned the Singhs that the Marathas were preparing to strike their camp under cover of alliance. Keeping faith with his earlier pledge, he gives them just enough notice to withdraw in good order rather than be caught in a surprise attack.

The Singhs leave camp in the afternoon and allow the Maratha force to believe they are retreating for good. Once the pursuers have come far enough, the Khalsa turns the movement into a trap, turned back and fired on the Marathas, and punishes the chase with disciplined violence.

After that sharp reversal, the Singhs pull away toward their own ground while the wider wreckage of Sirhind and Samand Khan's defeat remains in the background. The page portrays Sikh withdrawal not as weakness, but as tactical intelligence used to break an untrustworthy partner.
